author: taf141
quote: The world is a 10, but the actual game itself, the messaging and the story line and characters aren't even a 0 but a -10, because the game is overtly trying to give everyone a middle finger. Lucia represents the ultimate foid final boss, fat, looks like kevin gates, needing us to do everything for her approval, does nothing for us but gets us in trouble, keeps your son a secret while she is in prison, do you get mad, no, you buy her a gold necklace with the mexican son's name, why is there a zero percent possibility of getting an attractive well written girlfriend? It is because the women that made this are such trash themselves, with no inner life, and Lucia is a way for them to make themselves feel good, and while no one in development has ever met a man in real life, their cartoon character of what a man should be is a piece of cardboard that lives to clean up there mess, watch her flirt her way to higher status because she's a lazy do nothing, and basically be her slave even though she brings nothing to the table.
